_about: MiNar's great forest and grasslands (levels 6-18): timber and prairie wolves hunt in packs, poachers help each other, the hulking owlbears are elites, and Farrot the great roc in her nest beats up gales and calls owlbears from the forest.

43550.name: farrot roc great
43550.long_desc: Farrot the great roc settles on her nest, her shadow covering the clearing.
43550.description: A bird large enough to carry off a horse, with bronze feathers, a hooked beak like a ship's prow and talons longer than swords. The forest of MiNar falls silent when she flies.

phases.message: Farrot screams, and the whole forest shakes!
